tasks.gr11-exponents-surds-t1: Topic: Exponents and Surds. Cover rational exponents (a^(m/n) = n-th root of a^m), simplification of surd expressions, operations with surds (adding, subtracting, multiplying, rationalising), and solving equations containing surds. Ask Grade 11 learners to apply exponent laws to rational exponents, simplify mixed surd expressions, identify equivalent forms, and solve equations like √(2x−1) = 3 with verification of solutions.
tasks.gr11-equations-inequalities-t1: Topic: Equations and Inequalities. Cover completing the square, solving quadratic equations by factorisation, completing the square, and the quadratic formula; solving quadratic inequalities and representing solutions on a number line; the discriminant (Δ = b²−4ac) and nature of roots; and simultaneous equations with one linear and one quadratic. Ask Grade 11 learners to choose an appropriate method, interpret the discriminant, represent inequality solutions correctly, and set up equations from context.
tasks.gr11-number-patterns-t1: Topic: Number Patterns. Cover quadratic sequences, first and second differences, deriving the general term T_n = an² + bn + c from three or more terms, and modelling real-world situations with quadratic patterns. Ask Grade 11 learners to identify constant second differences, determine the value of a from 2a = second difference, find general terms using a system of equations, and predict missing terms or specific positions in a sequence.
tasks.gr11-analytical-geometry-t1: Topic: Analytical Geometry. Cover the gradient-intercept and two-point forms of a line, the inclination angle θ where m = tan θ (0° ≤ θ < 180°), conditions for parallel lines (equal gradients) and perpendicular lines (m₁ × m₂ = −1), the angle between two intersecting lines, and midpoint/distance formulae. Ask Grade 11 learners to determine line equations, calculate inclination angles, prove lines parallel or perpendicular, and solve coordinate geometry problems with clear reasoning.
